info.title: Oraclebot account and research API
info.description: Cloudflare account API and wallet-bound MCP2025-11-25 endpoint. Cookie mutations require same-origin CSRF checks; OAuth public-client PKCE endpoints and bearer MCP have separate authority. Trading uses explicitly signed finite preauthorization. A customer execution/delegation adapter remains unprovisioned; execution refuses when unavailable. Subscription checkout remains gated.

402.description: Stripe-confirmed active subscription or unexpired trial required

post.description: Starter: 3 configured bot slots. Advanced: 10. Unlimited: no subscription count cap. Paused and archived records do not reserve slots. Configured records remain inert paper definitions. Over-limit accounts retain reads, pause/archive and account deletion under existing cancellation rules. No activation/resume or live execution route exists.

post.description: The pending checkout lock lasts 35 minutes and matches the Stripe session expires_at. An ambiguous create is not retried. Only completion of that exact session can clear its lock before expiry.

post.summary: Open the configured Stripe portal for payment and cancellation independently of new Checkout launch
Verify raw Stripe HMAC, deduplicate event and reconcile current subscription state; never trust success redirects

schema.description: Unmodified Stripe event bytes. Signature timestamp must be within 300 seconds.

post.description: Verify the raw-body Stripe signature and reconcile the canonical subscription Price. Nonterminal events use an owned 30-second per-subscription D1 lease before fetching Stripe. Contention or lost ownership returns HTTP 503 without marking the event handled. Subscription, trial-use and receipt writes require the current unexpired owner. Cancellation events bypass the lease; existing terminal-state protection prevents stale updates restoring canceled access.

post.description: Starter: 10 completed runs/day, reset 00:00 UTC. Advanced and Unlimited: no daily count cap. Every plan has one in-flight run/account. Atomic reservations prevent concurrency/quota races; engine failures release the reservation. Input and engine resource bounds apply to all plans.
